executive_summary: Implements the chairman-ratified A-LOCAL leg1 landing rule (chairman 'I agree' SMS 2026-08-10T23:26Z ratifying Adam's recommendation, ruling capture c8ad4998), replacing the honest-unavailable interim shipped by SD-LEO-INFRA-DRIVE-SCORE-LEG1-001 (evidence ab82da6b: the old merge-base-ancestry rule measured 7/111 = 6.3% earnable). REVISED AT PLAN (TESTING evidence 8606170f, CONDITIONAL_PASS -> conditions incorporated below): the 98.3%/117-120 earnability figure cited during LEAD research describes ALL completed SDs (population P1), a population DISJOINT from the one FR-2 actually wires — computePlanCheckStatus's done[] (population P2: plan-of-record roadmap items promoted to an SD that then completed within a window). Freshly measured this SD: P2 is EMPTY at the 48h default AND at 168h (7 days); at 720h (30 days) it has ~20 items with an anchored landed rate of roughly 55-70% (two independent spot measurements varied in that range depending on git-log scan depth). This is honestly reported, not treated as a defect: the ratified contract's own empty-window clause ('empty window -> unavailable retained') already anticipates frequent unavailability, and this SD's job is to make leg1 measure HONESTLY when data exists, not to guarantee it is always non-empty. FR-2 therefore parameterizes and widens leg1's own window to 720h (empirically chosen so the population is non-empty often enough to be useful, while staying a real 'recently landed roadmap items' population, not a synthetic one) and scores PROPORTIONALLY rather than all-or-nothing, so the realistic ~55-70% landed rate registers as an honest partial measurement instead of a false zero. Two further conditions from TESTING are incorporated as hard requirements: (1) the end-anchor boundary must guard the dominant real collision shape (no-separator child suffixes, e.g. '-001' vs '-001A', measured 103 pairs across 5608 real SD keys -- 100x more common than the hyphenated '-001' vs '-001-B' shape, 1583 pairs, that LEAD research focused on); (2) the done[] fixture used in tests must be bound to the REAL computePlanCheckStatus output shape via a contract test, not hand-typed, because the exact field-name-mismatch class (reading a stale/wrong field name off a renamed producer, returning silent undefined -> false zero) is the literal harm LEG1-001 was built to prevent and is not self-evidently caught by a hand-written fixture. TR-3 is also corrected: SD-LEO-INFRA-DRIVE-SCORE-LEG2-001 is no longer an uncommitted sibling worktree -- it is PR #6953 (OPEN, mergeable), which changes buildGather()'s signature to REQUIRE readLeg2Cohort+nowMs (throws if absent). EXEC must rebase onto main after #6953 merges rather than hand-resolving a conflict against a moving target.

functional_requirements.title: Pure, end-anchored landing predicate with a content-returning git runner
functional_requirements.description: New file lib/drive-loop/score/leg1-landed-alocal.js exports a pure function (sdKey, {runGitLog}) -> boolean answering 'does an SD-key appear, end-anchored, in a merge-commit subject in main's history'. Reuses the query SHAPE already proven in scripts/lib/branch-resolver/domains/fallback.js checkMergeEvidence (git log main --merges --grep=<pattern> --format='%H %s') but does NOT call that function directly (it is unanchored and untested) -- this predicate fetches candidate subject lines via the injected runner then applies its OWN end-anchor check in JS. ANCHOR SPEC (measured over 5608 real sd_key values, TESTING evidence 8606170f): the key must be bounded on the left by line-start or a non-key character, and on the RIGHT by a negative lookahead (not a consuming class, so both a trailing '$' and an adjacent same-line match resolve correctly) against the charset [A-Za-z0-9._@-] -- this specifically defeats BOTH collision shapes found: the hyphenated child-suffix case ('-001' vs '-001-B', 1583 measured pairs) AND the dominant no-separator case ('-001' vs '-001A', 103 measured pairs, previously unguarded). Keys must be regex-escaped (they contain '.'). The existing runGit convention from the OLD leg1-landed.js returns only {ok:boolean} (sufficient for merge-base --is-ancestor's exit-code-only question) -- insufficient here, since the anchor check needs the actual subject-line TEXT, so this predicate defines a new injected shape: runGitLog: (args:string[]) => string[] (matched lines), consistent in spirit with the existing hand-written-double test convention (no mocking library).
acceptance_criteria: isSdLandedInMainHistory('SD-LEO-INFRA-DRIVE-SCORE-LEG1-001', {runGitLog}) returns true against a real or faked git-log double whose output contains that exact merge subject.
A key that is only a hyphenated PREFIX of a real merged child key (e.g. the DRIVE-LOOP-INSTRUMENT-001 vs -001-B/-C/-D/-E case) returns false.
A key that is only a NO-SEPARATOR prefix of a real merged key (e.g. a '-001' key when only a '-001A' variant merged) returns false -- the dominant, previously-unguarded collision shape.
Throws if runGitLog is not injected (mirrors the existing scoreLeg1 refuse-without-injection contract).

functional_requirements.title: Wire into drive-report-sweep leg1 gather using a widened, parameterized completed-items window, with non-all-or-nothing scoring and a producer-bound test fixture
functional_requirements.description: scripts/cron/drive-report-sweep.mjs buildGather(): call computePlanCheckStatus with an explicit, leg1-specific windowHours (720, empirically chosen -- 48h/168h were measured EMPTY at time of PLAN) rather than relying on the function's own 48h default, which other consumers may still use unchanged. When done.length === 0 (still a real, expected outcome even at 720h on a quiet week), leg1 stays unavailable byte-identical to the current LEG1-001 text (empty-window contract). When done.length > 0, replace the leg1 array entry with a real scored result: run the FR-1 predicate over every item's sd_key, dedupe both numerator and denominator (duplicate promoted items measured as real, e.g. one SD promoted twice across waves), exclude any item with a null/undefined sd_key from the denominator (mirrors the old leg's no-branch exclusion), and score PROPORTIONALLY: earned = LEG_POINTS * landedCount/denominator, denominator===0 always routes to the empty-window unavailable branch (never a 0/0 NaN). Round points.value to 2 decimal places before it is returned -- drive_score is append-only (UPDATE/DELETE both guarded) and an unrounded float already reaches a chairman-facing SMS format elsewhere in this pipeline (drive-report-sms.mjs) with no existing guard; leg1 should not add a second unrounded source into a table that cannot be corrected after the fact. All-or-nothing is explicitly rejected: LEAD/PLAN research measured a real false-negative tail (squash-merged PRs with no merge commit; landed-under-a-renamed/abbreviated key) that would zero the whole leg under an all-or-nothing rule even when the underlying signal honestly measures most of the population. CRITICAL TEST-FIXTURE REQUIREMENT: any test exercising this wiring must construct its done[]-shaped fixture via a thin factory that mirrors computePlanCheckStatus's ACTUAL return shape (sd_key sourced from item.promoted_to_sd_key, per lib/roadmap/plan-check-status.js:231-237) -- never a hand-typed object using a guessed or stale field name (e.g. promoted_to_sd_key directly on the done[] row, which does not exist on the real output and would silently read as undefined -> false zero, the exact harm this SD exists to prevent). A dedicated contract test must assert the fixture-factory's keys match the real function's documented output shape.
acceptance_criteria: Empty done[] (at windowHours=720) -> leg1 unavailable_legs entry is byte-identical to the current LEG1-001 reason text (no regression on the existing pinned tests at tests/unit/cron/drive-report-sweep.test.js:370-382).

Non-empty done[] -> leg1 appears in driveScore.measured_legs with points.value proportional to landedCount/denominator, rounded to 2 decimals, denominator counted after deduping and excluding null sd_key.
A contract test proves the done[]-fixture factory's field names match computePlanCheckStatus's real output shape (not just an isolated hand-typed guess).
FR-2 introduces zero new Supabase queries beyond the explicit windowHours override on the existing computePlanCheckStatus call.

functional_requirements.title: Two-sided controls, causally-discriminating regression guards, and scoring edge cases
functional_requirements.description: tests/unit/drive-loop/score/leg1-landed-alocal.test.js (new) plus additions to tests/unit/cron/drive-report-sweep.test.js. Six scenarios, each independently falsifiable and CI-persistent (not a prove-once-then-discard authoring ritual): (1) POSITIVE -- a known-landed completed SD key measures landed=true; (2) NEGATIVE -- a fabricated never-landed key measures landed=false; (3) END-ANCHOR GUARD, both shapes -- a hyphenated child-prefix key and a no-separator child-prefix key each must NOT measure landed against a fixture containing only the child's real merge; (4) POPULATION-DISCRIMINATION GUARD -- a single fixture where done[] and open_items_all are constructed to DISAGREE by design (done[] contains 2 really-landed keys, open_items_all contains 2 different fabricated never-landed keys): scoring against done[] must equal LEG_POINTS (2/2), scoring the SAME predicate against a helper that reads from open_items_all instead must equal 0 -- this is a same-test negative control proving the fixture is non-vacuous, not merely a swap-and-observe-red ceremony during authoring; (5) DENOMINATOR-ZERO GUARD -- an empty done[] scores as unavailable, never 0/0 = NaN; (6) DEDUPE AND NULL-EXCLUSION GUARD -- a done[] containing a duplicate sd_key and a null sd_key scores using the deduped, null-excluded denominator, not the raw array length.
acceptance_criteria: All 6 scenarios exist as independently named, CI-persistent test cases (not folded into one assertion each, not deleted after proving the point once).

Scenario 4's two assertions live in the same test (or an explicitly paired pair), both reading from field names bound to the real computePlanCheckStatus/open_items_all shapes per FR-2's contract-test requirement.
Existing pinned tests (leg-set identity, possible===0-with-3-unavailable-legs when window is empty) remain green unmodified.

functional_requirements.title: Amend the OLD leg1-landed.js header and its test-assertion message to mark it reference-only, superseded by A-LOCAL
functional_requirements.description: lib/drive-loop/score/leg1-landed.js is NOT deleted or behaviorally modified (its cherry-pick-vs-ancestry divergence test still has standalone value, and it has a real, if currently zero, potential future caller). Its header comment, which argues at length that ancestry is 'the one git question this leg is permitted to ask,' is amended with a short note that the LIVE leg1 rule is now A-LOCAL (leg1-landed-alocal.js, ruling c8ad4998) and this file is reference/historical only. TESTING also flagged (evidence 8606170f) that the file's own test assertion message ('the leg is all-or-nothing') and aggregate.js's header prose ('at 2 points each') both read as authoritative documentation that now contradicts shipped behavior for the LIVE leg1 rule -- leg1-landed.js's own test message is corrected to scope its claim to itself ('this reference implementation is all-or-nothing') rather than leg1 generally; aggregate.js's header is left untouched (it describes aggregate's own per-leg-agnostic contract correctly -- 'at 2 points each' refers to LEG_POINTS as a constant ceiling, not to any leg's internal scoring shape, so it is not actually contradicted, only potentially misread; no code change needed there, verified during PLAN, not deferred).
acceptance_criteria: Header amendment is additive (a short note block), not a rewrite of the existing ancestry-vs-cherry argument, which remains historically accurate for that file's own function.
scoreLeg1/ancestryArgs exports remain byte-unchanged; only the header comment and the one flagged test-assertion message string are edited.

technical_requirements.title: Reuse the proven query shape, not the untested function
technical_requirements.description: checkMergeEvidence (fallback.js:134-198) proves the git log main --merges --grep=... --format='%H %s' shape works and is fast, but it is itself unanchored and has zero behavioral test coverage. FR-1's predicate borrows the query shape via its own injected runGitLog seam; it does not import or call checkMergeEvidence, and does not modify fallback.js (out of scope -- that function has other live callers via checkPostMergeFallback).

technical_requirements.title: No change to the ratified 3-leg SSOT
technical_requirements.description: drive-score-legs.js's DRIVE_SCORE_LEGS/RATIFICATION/LEG_POINTS are untouched. LEG_ID ('leg1_landed') is reused as-is from the SSOT -- this SD changes HOW leg1 is measured, not what leg1 IS.

technical_requirements.title: Rebase onto main AFTER PR #6953 merges; do not hand-resolve against a moving target
technical_requirements.description: SD-LEO-INFRA-DRIVE-SCORE-LEG2-001 is PR #6953 (OPEN, mergeable at PLAN time), which changes buildGather()'s parameter list to REQUIRE readLeg2Cohort+nowMs (throws without them) and touches the same legs array and the same test describe blocks this SD edits. A clean textual merge against #6953's current diff would still produce a semantic break (LEG1's tests constructing buildGather() with today's arg shape would throw once the new required params ship). EXEC must check PR #6953's merge state before opening its own PR; if still open, either wait for it to merge and rebase, or coordinate explicit sequencing with the coordinator -- never hand-resolve a conflict against an in-flight, still-changing PR.

test_scenarios.scenario: End-anchor regression guard, both collision shapes
test_scenarios.expected: A hyphenated child-prefix key AND a no-separator child-prefix key both fail to measure landed against a fixture containing only the child's real merge

test_scenarios.scenario: Population-discrimination guard (done[] vs open_items_all, same-test negative control)
test_scenarios.expected: Scoring against done[] yields the expected non-zero result; scoring the identical predicate against open_items_all in the same test yields 0 -- proving the fixture is non-vacuous
Empty done[] scores as unavailable, never 0/0=NaN
Duplicate sd_key and null sd_key entries are excluded from the denominator correctly, not counted at raw array length
Empty done[] at windowHours=720 leaves leg1's unavailable reason byte-identical to LEG1-001's shipped text

acceptance_criteria: Diff scoped to: lib/drive-loop/score/leg1-landed-alocal.js (new), lib/drive-loop/score/leg1-landed.js (header + one test-message amendment only), scripts/cron/drive-report-sweep.mjs, tests/unit/drive-loop/score/leg1-landed-alocal.test.js (new), tests/unit/cron/drive-report-sweep.test.js.
No changes to drive-score-legs.js, aggregate.js, or fallback.js.
All 8 TS scenarios pass; existing pinned tests (leg-set identity, empty-window possible===0) remain green.

Chairman-facing drive-score surfaces render leg1 as a real, rounded, proportionally-scored value when the 720h window has data, or the unchanged honest-unavailable text when it does not -- never a false zero, never an unrounded float reaching the append-only table.
EXEC confirms PR #6953's merge state before opening this SD's own PR (TR-3) and does not hand-resolve against an in-flight signature change.

risks.risk: Merge conflict / semantic break against PR #6953 (SD-LEO-INFRA-DRIVE-SCORE-LEG2-001) on the same file/array/test blocks and buildGather() signature.
risks.mitigation: TR-3: EXEC checks #6953's state before shipping; rebase after merge rather than hand-resolving a textually-clean but semantically-broken merge.

risks.risk: The realistic ~55-70% (at 720h, spot-measured) landed rate for the actually-wired population is far below the 98.3% figure ratified based on a different, broader population -- if read out of context, this could look like a regression rather than the correct, honest first measurement.
risks.mitigation: Executive summary and FR-2 explicitly state the population-specific number; proportional scoring (not all-or-nothing) ensures this shows as an honest partial measurement, not a false zero or false full score.

risks.risk: Unrounded fractional points.value reaching the append-only drive_score table or chairman SMS.
risks.mitigation: FR-2 rounds to 2 decimals at the point of computation, defensively, without depending on a fix to the broader SMS formatter (out of this SD's scope).
